note: Positions are lat/lon (degrees); ground positions are metres east (x) and north (y) of the aerodrome reference point. query of=chart returns the fixes, holds, runways, runway exits and entries, and gates; the rest is only here. Here, entries are the entry fixes; ground.entries are the runway entries.

ground.note: The full taxi graph (nodes and edges with taxiway refs) is docs/taxi_graph.json.

arrival_flows_note: N or S: the feeder side. "B": Center sends each arrival to the side with fewer arrivals planned at the time (flights row feeder_side).
